Outcome.description:
Normalised result of one test execution.

JUnit XML distinguishes a *failure* (an assertion did not hold) from an *error* (the test
could not run to its assertion, e.g. an exception in set-up). Both count as "not passed";
they stay separate because they usually need different people to act.

RunContext.description:
Where and on what a run executed; every field is optional because files rarely say.

Values come from the import command (``--framework``, ``--environment`` ...) and, when the
producer records them, from JUnit properties. Runs are only compared with each other when
their contexts match (see docs/metrics.md, "comparable executions").
